controlFinalReview.reviewer: WikiBiome Control Tower scientific, source-resolution, and editorial audit

reviewStandard: All six routes fail the pre-generation identity, composition, evidence, or non-prescriptive representation gate. Four have zero linked sources, the ASD route's five declared source identifiers are malformed and do not resolve, and the general probiotics route has only one strain-taxonomy source while spanning many distinct organisms, products, conditions, and claimed effects. No marked generation prompt, call, raster, or eligible source hash exists.
promotionRule: No Batch 110 source hash exists or is eligible for promotion. All six routes remain asset-free scientific holds. No master, derivative, registry record, endpoint, Schema object, social preview, or image-sitemap record may be created from this batch.

routeDecisions.reason: The zero-source PCOS route combines inulin and fructooligosaccharide families without selecting molecular distribution, chain length, linkage profile, ingredient source, ratio, purity, product, preparation, dose, duration, comparator, assay, or endpoint.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Link direct evidence and choose exact inulin and fructooligosaccharide specifications, chain-length distributions and linkages, ingredient sources and processing, ratio, purity, formulation, dose and schedule, PCOS population, comparator, adherence, specimen, assay, time point, endpoint, and safety boundary.

routeDecisions.reason: The zero-source route names three organism labels but supplies no strain accessions, per-strain viable counts, allocation, product or lot, excipients, storage, CKD stage, dose, duration, comparator, assay, or endpoint.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Link direct evidence and recover current taxon names and exact strain accessions, per-strain counts and allocation, product and lot, excipients, storage, dosing protocol, CKD stage and population, comparator, adherence, specimen, assay, time point, endpoint, and safety exclusions.

routeDecisions.reason: The broad route spans bacterial and yeast taxa, single- and multi-strain products, many conditions, ecological mechanisms, doses, and safety states. Its sole resolved source establishes the reassignment of strain 35624 rather than one representative probiotic product or observable state.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split or scope the class page to one governed visual taxonomy, or select a specific product with current taxon names, exact strain accessions, viable counts and allocation, formulation, storage, route, dose, population, comparator, assay, endpoint, safety boundaries, and direct evidence.

routeDecisions.reason: The zero-source PCOS route names four organism labels but no current strain accessions, viable counts, allocation, product, formulation, storage, dose, duration, comparator, adherence, assay, endpoint, or safety state.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Link direct PCOS evidence and recover current organism names, exact strain accessions, per-strain counts and allocation, product and lot, excipients, storage, dosing protocol, PCOS population, comparator, adherence, specimen, assay, time point, endpoint, and safety exclusions.

routeDecisions.reason: All five declared local source identifiers include erroneous `.md` suffixes and fail normal source resolution. The route also spans many incompletely identified taxa, variable products and doses, heterogeneous outcomes, and speculative mechanistic claims rather than one bounded probiotic intervention.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Correct all source identifiers, reconcile each claim to direct evidence, and select current taxon names, exact strain accessions, per-strain counts and allocation, product and lot, formulation, storage, dose and duration, ASD population, comparator, adherence, specimen, assay, time point, endpoint, non-stigmatizing visual scope, and safety exclusions.

routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Link direct evidence and select current taxon names, exact strain accessions, per-strain counts and allocation, product and lot, excipients, storage, route and dose, Hashimoto disease state and population, comparator, adherence, specimen, assay, time point, endpoint, and safety exclusions.
